name: infra-brain
description: infra-brain development environment — infrastructure audit agent with full LangChain Lab integration, domain-specific skills, safety hooks, and orchestration routing.

skills.name: orchestrate
skills.description: Master routing skill. Routes any task to the right skill, subagent, and workflow sequence. Start here for any new work.

skills.name: agent-register
skills.description: Full workflow for registering a new domain agent: scaffold, wire into supervisor and scheduler, run completeness check.

skills.name: agent-scaffold
skills.description: Create a new domain agent file and matching test file from the project template.

skills.name: sweep-debug
skills.description: Diagnose failed or empty sweeps via 5-layer triage: DB, audit_log, Redis, logs, LangSmith.

skills.name: dev-status
skills.description: 10-check developer tooling health audit: registry, tests, schedules, callbacks, migrations, k8s, env parity, SQL.

skills.name: migration-create

skills.name: deploy-check
skills.description: Full pre-deployment validation checklist before pushing to master.

skills.name: validate-sql
skills.description: Run the static SQL column validator on all UI queries to catch column name drift.

skills.name: openui-sync
skills.description: Audit OpenUI component library vs API endpoints: cross-check each component has a backing endpoint, report orphans and opportunities.

skills.name: lc:start

skills.name: lc:rag

skills.name: lc:memory

skills.name: lc:tools

skills.name: lc:lcel

skills.name: lc:deploy

skills.name: lc:test

skills.name: lc:debug

skills.name: lc:monitor

skills.name: lc:audit

skills.name: lc:providers

skills.name: lc:ui

skills.name: lc:data
skills.description: Text-to-SQL, safe SQL tool, Pandas agent, OpenAPI agent, multi-source data.

skills.name: lc:vectorstore
skills.description: pgvector, Chroma, Pinecone, hybrid search, multi-tenant namespacing.

skills.name: lc:multimodal
skills.description: Image analysis, PDF loaders, table extraction, audio, multimodal RAG.

skills.name: lc:context-engineer
skills.description: Prompt templates, system prompts, few-shot examples, structured output.

skills.name: lc:patterns

skills.name: lc:explain
skills.description: Explain any LangChain/LangGraph concept with analogy, code, and common mistakes.

skills.name: lc:docs
skills.description: Fetch live documentation via Context7. Up-to-date API reference.

skills.name: lc:review
skills.description: Review LangChain code across 5 dimensions: correctness, best practices, performance, pitfalls, production.

skills.name: lc:scaffold
skills.description: Scaffold project/agent/graph/RAG/tool/chain/evaluator/dockerfile files.

skills.name: lc:trace
skills.description: Inject LangSmith tracing into an existing Python file.

skills.name: lc:guard
skills.description: Audit project for 8 security gaps and generate a guardrails layer.

skills.name: lc:erase
skills.description: GDPR Article 17 right-to-erasure: generate erasure script + audit SQL + 30-day deadline.

skills.name: lc:antipatterns
skills.description: Interactive catalog of 15 LangChain antipatterns with fixes.

skills.name: ci-debug
skills.description: Diagnose failing GitLab CI pipelines for infra-brain (project 42): fetch job traces, classify failure type (YAML, runner, test, build, deploy, CVE), suggest copy-paste fix.

skills.name: tool-register
skills.description: Register a new LangChain @tool for an infra-brain domain agent. Creates tool file, test file, wires into agent, runs lc-safety-reviewer, runs tests.

skills.name: onboard
skills.description: infra-brain-specific onboarding: safety model, 23-domain agent architecture, read-only guarantee, task map, critical constraints, and first contribution guide.

skills.name: openui-sync
skills.description: Audit and sync the OpenUI custom-views feature: check the prompt.py generator freshness and the custom_views schema against infra-brain API endpoints and the React custom-views components under dashboard-app/src/.

agents.name: infra-researcher
agents.description: Read-only parallel research agent. Spawned by the orchestrator to gather context before implementation. Reads files, checks registries, inspects test structure, queries git history.

agents.name: lc-safety-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews changes to callbacks/, supervisor.py, or tools/ for safety: callback registration, sync/async mismatches, read-only enforcement, DLP bypass paths.

agents.name: lc-migration-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews Alembic migrations for safety: NOT NULL without defaults, DROP TABLE, missing CONCURRENTLY, missing lock_timeout.

agents.name: lc-api-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews FastAPI routes for async/sync correctness, missing auth, sync DB calls, missing response_model.

agents.name: lc-agent-completeness
agents.description: Validates new domain agents have all 4 wiring points: agent file, test file, AGENT_REGISTRY entry, scheduler entry.

agents.name: sweep-health
agents.description: Cross-domain sweep health reporter. Queries collection_runs via postgres-infra MCP for all 23 domains. Reports status, resource counts, drift counts, and flags overdue or failed domains.

agents.name: drift-analyst
agents.description: Per-domain drift comparison agent. Queries the two most recent completed runs and compares drift_events: N new, N resolved, N persistent, resource delta. Requires postgres-infra MCP.
